subject: Request: Provisional coverage bridge note for SOC 2 Type II post-report gap
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <h.lee@umbratek.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@umbratek.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provisional bridge note to cover post-report period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier. To finish our internal review we need a provisional bridge note (bridgenote / interim attestation) that covers the period after Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report.

A few specifics from our side:
- Report end date: 2026-12-31 (we have a copy of the Type II report).
- Coverage requested: 2027-01-01 through 2027-03-31 (Q1).
- What we need from you: a signed bridge letter that states there were no material control changes and a short evidence pack (controls changed list, last configuration snapshot, and confirmation on KMS rotations since the report).

Can Redwood provide a draft bridgenote and an estimate for a signed letter (we need it for our procurement sign-off)? Also can you send any standard template you use — we'll push through our legal/procurement quickly if the language is standard.

We may need DocuSign for signature; please include a link when ready.

Appreciate the help — aim is to close by Apr 8 if possible.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Security & Compliance Lead
Umbratek

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Looping in Kim (security/compliance), Karthik (audit ops) and Marissa (legal) so we can coordinate a bridgenote that fits your procurement needs.

High-level plan:
1) We will produce a draft bridgenote (Redwood standard template) and an evidence index for the Q1 window.
2) Compliance will review and sign; we can provide an e-signed PDF via DocuSign.
3) Typical turnaround for a final signed bridgenote + minimal evidence pack is 3 business days once we have the signatory cleared — we should be able to hit your Apr 8 target if we start today.

Kim/Karthik/Marissa — can you confirm: is the requested coverage strictly the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31? Any specific control areas Umbratek wants us to call out (e.g., KMS, change control, vulnerability management)? Karthik — please attach the usual 'period summary' spreadsheet and the draft bridgenote template.

Hannah — I'll follow up with a draft within the next 24 hours.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Operations

Summary / what we'll provide:
- Draft bridgenote (standard Redwood language stating no material control changes and listing minor operational items since report end).
- Period summary spreadsheet (high-level inventory snapshot as of 2027-03-31, KMS rotation note, and change-control highlights).
- Evidence index: we will compile logs/config snapshots for: KMS rotations since 2026-12-31, highest-risk change tickets closed in Q1, and vulnerability scanning summary for Q1.

Timeline:
- Draft to Hannah by EOD Thu Apr 1 (today).
- Internal compliance/legal review Fri Apr 2.
- Final sign & DocuSign Mon Apr 5 (target) — ready to expedite if Umbratek needs earlier.

Kim — can you confirm signatory (typically Head of Security or VP of Ops)? Marissa — please flag any legal language we should avoid for procurement.

Thanks,

Thanks Karthik — received the draft and the period summary. A couple quick items from procurement/legal side:

- Preferred signatory: we accept Director-level or above (Head of Security is fine).
- We will countersign in DocuSign; please include procurement@umbratek.com as the signing group.
- For the evidence index: the KMS rotation note and change-control highlights are the most important. If you can include a one-page bullet list of the Q1 vulnerability remediation posture (top 5 fix items), that will speed internal approval.

If you can get the final signed bridgenote into DocuSign with procurement included by Apr 5, we’ll be able to close our review and move to PO issuance the same week.

Appreciate the quick coordination — let me know if you need anything else from our side.

Best,
